scoring_justification: Full recompute of Monte Carlo free energy method is computationally infeasible in the verifier; compare agent-reported aggregated stage free energy differences and final macroscopic properties against paper-reported gold values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold free energy differences, surface tension, and excess internal energy for the 216-particle LJ 6:12 fluid at T*=0.7, ρ*=0.85.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: J. Miyazaki et al., J. Chem. Phys. 64, 3364 (1976). Values from Table I (intermediate C values summed to Fc-Fb=55.73ε), text (Fb-Fa=96.72ε, Fd-Fc=-69.69ε, Fe-Fd=-9.97ε, Ff-Fe=-7.86ε, total ΔF=64.93ε), and Table II (γ=18.3±0.3 dyn/cm, U_s=38.9±0.8 erg/cm²).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper; not fabricated.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported results; they serve as the authoritative reproduction target.

outputs.description: Final aggregated results: total free energy of surface creation, surface tension, excess internal energy, and the five stage free energy differences. The checker compares these to the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The perturbation theory correction (BFW+ATM) is not required for this core reproduction.

steps.description: Total free energy (sum of five stages) compared to paper gold 64.93ε
